controlSet.description: Preserve the originating principal across every hop and refresh.
Require every non-root hop to reference a verifiable parent.
Require granted scope to be equal to or narrower than received scope.
Preserve immutable transaction and original-intent references.
Require evidence that scope semantics remain bounded across trust domains.
Evaluate the aggregate effect of converging branches against the parent mandate.
Propagate preventive revocation and record interruption and compensation outcomes.

threats.description: A downstream hop gains broader authority than its parent.
A local actor is valid but cannot be resolved to the originating principal.
Valid branches combine into an unauthorized aggregate effect.

transitions.actor: originating principal or authorized revocation authority
